Homeowner: Access their authorized property/account, make payments, manage permitted household information, submit requests, use community services, and exercise verified voting rights.

Tenant / Authorized Occupant: Access permitted communications, requests, amenities, directory, parking, and visitor functions for their assigned unit. No owner finances or ownership voting rights by default.
HOA Administrator: Manage assigned community operations, onboarding, records, settings, work queues, and approved role assignments.
HOA President: Coordinate board responsibilities, communications, reviews, and authorized decisions.
HOA Secretary: Manage minutes, governing records, notices, documents, and assigned governance tasks.
HOA Treasurer: View financial records, reconcile/export reports, and perform explicitly authorized assessment and adjustment tasks.
Board Member: Access permitted board materials, financial summaries, assigned tasks, reviews, and decisions.
Management Company Admin: Manage assigned communities, company staff assignments, shared templates, and authorized operational reporting.
Property Manager: Handle assigned community operations, communications, work queues, and explicitly delegated financial or review tasks.
Platform Owner: Manage platform configuration, organizations, staff permissions, subscription operations, and authorized exceptional recovery.
Platform Support: Investigate technical issues through approved, limited, time-bound access.
Platform Viewer: View authorized platform health, adoption, and summary reporting without editing or unrestricted household-level access.
Community Account Owner: Controls the community’s HOAhx subscription, purchases, changes, cancellation, and authorized account handoff.
Billing Administrator: Manages subscription payment details and invoices without cancellation or ownership-transfer authority.
Backup Contact: Receives continuity notices and can request an account-owner transfer.
Primary Property Owner: Verified property contact designation that does not remove co-owner rights.
Primary Communication Contact: Receives designated property notices; billing recipients remain separately configurable.
Household Administrator: Manages permitted household details and membership.
Rental Manager: Manages explicitly delegated rental/occupancy tasks for specified properties and dates.
Committee Member / Assigned Reviewer: Accesses assigned review records; final decision authority requires a separate permission.

Resident and property data onboarding: The HOA should be able to upload its existing CSV or Excel file. HOAhx would use AI-assisted mapping to match the columns to our required fields, flag anything that doesn’t look right, and let the admin review and approve everything before it’s imported into the platform.

Monthly financial reporting: We already show the HOA’s budget and where the money is supposed to go, but we also need a way for the HOA to upload its monthly financial statements showing where the money actually went. HOAhx would pull that information into the financial dashboard so homeowners can easily compare budgeted versus actual spending, while still having access to the detailed reports.
